    class IsProper : Prop extends IsSeparated f, UniversallyClosed f, LocallyOfFiniteType f
QuasiCompact is NOT a field -- the module docstring says so explicitly ("we do not require quasi-compact, since this is implied by universally closed"). And Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean had ALREADY PROVED two of the three, before this run, as theorems adjacent to the sorry:

It even had Pic0.quasiCompact, with a docstring correctly noting it is not needed for the proper assembly. So the sorry was standing next to two thirds of its own proof.

And it is further reducible: the already-proved Pic0.universallyClosed_of_baseChange (Stacks 02KS fpqc descent, via MorphismProperty.of_pullback_snd_of_descendsAlong) takes universal closedness of the base change to k-bar and returns it over k -- so Kleiman s projectivity argument is only needed over an algebraically closed field.

GENERALISABLE LESSON, the reason this is worth a memory rather than just a commit: before attacking a sorry whose conclusion is a mathlib STRUCTURE (IsProper, IsFinite, IsAffine...), enumerate that structure s fields and grep the file for each one. A multi-field target can be two thirds discharged by theorems already in the same file.
